name: aem-eds-personalization
description: Section-based personalization for AEM Edge Delivery Services (DA) pages, following the EDS personalization contract: Section Metadata rows let rules (geo, device, visitor, URL/UTM param, page state, custom audiences), a decision engine (v1 API, OF1), an A/B split or Adobe Target (inline or popup) pick the EDS fragment a section shows, with the authored content as default. Consent first, measurement events per decision, a client runtime plus an optional Cloudflare edge worker, a simulator and Playwright checks.
